identity.title: Silent Forest
identity.idea: After a heavy day, a person can finally exhale.

human.why_choose_them: She knows how to listen — really listen.

identity.brand_story: Noah built Praxis Klarheit because she knows how to listen — really listen. Clients (30–50) should feel relief. Only then do we name the craft: psychology.
identity.core_promise: After a heavy day, a person can finally exhale.
identity.visual_metaphor: a clearing in the trees where noise stops
identity.scene_language: hushed rooms, deep green quiet, one path inward
identity.motion_language: slow breathe — fade like mist, never bounce
identity.color_emotion: deep moss, fog grey, warm wood — never neon
identity.photo_world: forest edge at dusk, empty chair, soft window light
identity.agency_note: Think like a creative agency director on a €50,000 brief. No idea → no HTML. Creative Identity becomes site, store, social, video, ads.
identity.question: Who is the human — and what idea can you feel?
identity.not_question: How do we assemble a psychologist website?
